Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application

Class OperatorAccess

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.OperatorAccess
public final class OperatorAccess extends Object
Creates the first account, authenticates operators and resets a forgotten password, without exposing entities.

The password reset is a simulation: the e-mail address is checked for shape and then forgotten, and nothing is sent. VarZinho runs on one machine with no mail server.

    • createFirst

      public SignedInOperator createFirst(String name, String username, String password) throws RepositoryException
      Creates the first operator account and signs it in. Only possible while there is none.
      Parameters:
      name - the operator's name
      username - the name to sign in with
      password - the password, following the operator's password rules
      Returns:
      the new operator, signed in
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if an operator account already exists
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name, username or password is invalid
      RepositoryException - if the operators cannot be read or written

    • signIn

      public SignedInOperator signIn(String username, String password) throws RepositoryException
      Signs an operator in. An unknown username and a wrong password fail the same way, so the message does not tell which usernames exist.
      Parameters:
      username - the username, in any case
      password - the password
      Returns:
      the signed-in operator
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the username or password is incorrect
      RepositoryException - if the operators cannot be read

    • requestPasswordReset

      public void requestPasswordReset(String username, String email) throws RepositoryException
      Accepts a request for a password reset link. No link is sent: the caller moves straight on to resetPassword(java.lang.String, java.lang.String).
      Parameters:
      username - the operator asking
      email - where the link would go; checked for shape, then forgotten
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the username is blank or unknown, or the e-mail address is not well formed
      RepositoryException - if the operators cannot be read

    • resetPassword

      public void resetPassword(String username, String newPassword) throws RepositoryException
      Gives the operator a new password, keeping the name and the username.
      Parameters:
      username - the operator whose password changes
      newPassword - the new password
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the username is unknown or the password breaks the operator's password rules; the old password then still works
      RepositoryException - if the operators cannot be read or written
